# tensquads UI component index

@tensquads/ui is a React component library with 26 documented components. Live gallery: https://tensquads-ui-preview.mohanadgh.workers.dev/components. Install and setup: README.md. Agent skill: .agents/skills/tensquads-ui/SKILL.md.

- [ApprovalCard](packages/ui/src/react/ApprovalCard/ApprovalCard.md): Import `ApprovalCard` and `ApprovalCardProps` from `@tensquads/ui/react`. Pass a platform `approval_request` as `request`. The card displays its action, content, optional labeled rule and limit, and approve or decline controls. `actionLabels` localizes action ids. `ruleLabels` maps rule ids to human-readable labels; an unmapped rule id is hidden. A limit is always shown when present. Optional `bot` values display a Squadmate only when they match a known slug. Optional `taskId` and `decision` values come from the host because they are not fields on the approval request.
- [Badge](packages/ui/src/react/Badge/Badge.md): Import `Badge` and the `BadgeProps` type from `@tensquads/ui/react`. Badge is a plain, non-interactive `<span>` because UI SDK does not ship a Badge component or behavior for this label. It has no hand-authored ARIA role and is not focusable.
- [BarChart](packages/ui/src/react/BarChart/BarChart.md): Import `BarChart`, `BarChartProps`, `BarChartPoint`, `BarChartSegment`, and `BarChartKey` from `@tensquads/ui/react`. Pass ordered points with a date label and either a numeric `value` or an array of `{ key, value }` segments. Pass `keys` to name stacked series and select `muted`, `subtle`, `strong`, `success`, or `danger` ink. Use `subtle` for light historical comparison marks. Set `highlight` to an inclusive `[startIndex, endIndex]` range. Without a range, the last column is highlighted. A matching key's tone takes precedence over the highlight. Bars scale from a zero baseline; zero-valued segments have no visible mark. For integer data, the value axis rounds up to a nice maximum and shows three whole-number tick labels. Fractional data uses the largest point total, with a minimum axis maximum of 1, and can show fractional ticks. Pass `formatValue` to format axis ticks, accessible column names, and tooltip values, for example with a currency formatter. `formatValue` is a React-only callback and is not available in OpenUI streams. Hover or focus on a column to see its label, total, and stacked-series values in a tooltip. The chart includes a text summary, and its columns share one tab stop. Left and Right arrow keys move focus in the inherited layout direction. Points follow caller order from the inline start; pass the oldest point first for a time series. The x-axis shows every point label for up to 14 points. Longer series show the first label and every fifth label after it, with an aligned slot for every column. Wide charts scroll within their viewport. Wrap it in `Card`; put the metric and time window in the Card subtitle. Pass `locale="ar"` to localize generated labels and screen-reader copy; the default is English. OpenUI accepts the same `locale` prop.
- [Bars](packages/ui/src/react/Bars/Bars.md): Import `Bars`, `BarsProps`, and `BarsRow` from `@tensquads/ui/react`. Each row has a label, a non-negative numeric `value` used for scale, and a `display` string shown to the reader. The component sorts rows by value in descending order and shows up to eight. Fills scale to the largest value, including fractional values; an all-zero dataset has empty fills. The default `ranked` style shows horizontal magnitude bars. Use `style="progress"` for plan rows and pass a `caption` for the average or other context. Growth may use `tone="info"` for the blue fill shown in the store owner reference; all other rows use one neutral ink. Wrap the chart in `Card`.
- [Button](packages/ui/src/react/Button/Button.md): Import `Button` and the `ButtonProps` type from `@tensquads/ui/react`. It wraps UI SDK's `Button` from `@ui-sdk/react/button` and keeps its native button behavior, `data-slot`, `render` prop, and forwarded props.
- [Card](packages/ui/src/react/Card/Card.md): Import `Card` and `CardProps` from `@tensquads/ui/react`. Card is a dashboard panel with one body. It accepts `title`, optional `subtitle`, `count`, `actions`, `legend`, `footer`, and `flush`. The `inset` variant creates a nested item surface. Use `flush` when a table or other edge-to-edge content fills the body. Keep controls in the page header except for the table search and filters allowed by D24.
- [Chat](packages/ui/src/react/Chat/Chat.md): Import `Chat`, `ChatHeader`, `ChatLog`, `ChatUserMessage`, `ChatAssistantMessage`, `ChatWorking`, `ChatError`, `ChatStep`, `ChatEmptyState`, and `ChatComposer` from `@tensquads/ui/react`. Chat parts build a chat surface: a scrolling log, user messages, agent replies, working and error lines, and a composer. The host renders an agent reply as React content inside `ChatAssistantMessage`, with no avatar, name, or bubble. Use `ChatStep` for rows that report work by named agents.
- [ChatLauncher](packages/ui/src/react/ChatLauncher/ChatLauncher.md): Import `ChatLauncher` from `@tensquads/ui/react`. It is a floating button for opening the assistant chat. The host supplies `onClick` and controls navigation. `label`, `waiting`, and `locale` set its localized label and optional waiting count. The accessible name includes the count. The OpenUI definition accepts `label`, `waiting`, and `locale`; host navigation remains a React callback.
- [ChatReply](packages/ui/src/react/ChatReply/ChatReply.md): Import `ChatReply` and `ChatReplyProps` from `@tensquads/ui/react`. Pass a streaming reply string and its active locale. ChatReply renders Markdown text and fenced `openui` blocks in reading order. Each OpenUI block uses `TensquadsRenderer`; renderer props pass through except for the action and locking adaptations described below.
- [Chip](packages/ui/src/react/Chip/Chip.md): Import `Chip` and `ChipProps` from `@tensquads/ui/react`. Chip wraps UI SDK `Button` from `@ui-sdk/react/button`. A chip opens an attached object, so it uses button action behavior without a pressed state.
- [DataTable](packages/ui/src/react/DataTable/DataTable.md): Import `DataTable`, its column and row types, and the `EntityCell`, `PersonCell`, `StackCell`, and `StatusCell` helpers from `@tensquads/ui/react`. Provide an accessible `caption`, columns, and rows with stable string IDs. Cells accept text or React nodes. Set `align: "end"` for numeric columns and optionally set `width` or `mono`. `EntityCell` derives uppercase Latin initials from the first two words, or the first two letters when the name has one word.
- [Dialog](packages/ui/src/react/Dialog/Dialog.md): Import `Dialog`, its parts, and the matching prop types from `@tensquads/ui/react`. Dialog wraps UI SDK's `@ui-sdk/react/dialog` parts: `Dialog`, `DialogTrigger`, `DialogBackdrop`, `DialogContent`, `DialogTitle`, `DialogDescription`, and `DialogClose`. Each part keeps its UI SDK `data-slot`, `render` prop, open-state API, and forwarded props. The wrapper adds Agent-UI classes only.
- [Distribution](packages/ui/src/react/Distribution/Distribution.md): Import `Distribution`, `DistributionProps`, and `DistributionPart` from `@tensquads/ui/react`. Pass parts with a label and non-negative count. Parts are sorted by count in descending order; when there are more than six, the first five remain and the rest are folded into `Other` (`أخرى` in Arabic). The stacked bar uses neutral greys, and the key shows each label and bold count. Hover a segment to see its label and count in a native title. The whole and its parts are available in a screen-reader summary. Wrap it in `Card`. Pass `locale="ar"` to localize generated labels and screen-reader copy; the default is English. OpenUI accepts the same `locale` prop.
- [EmptyState](packages/ui/src/react/EmptyState/EmptyState.md): Import `EmptyState` from `@tensquads/ui/react`. Provide a short `title`, one sentence `description`, and optionally one action element. Use it in place of content when there are no records or when filtering returns no matches. The host chooses the action that will produce data.
- [Field](packages/ui/src/react/Field/Field.md): Import `Field`, `FieldLabel`, `FieldControl`, `FieldDescription`, `FieldError`, and their prop types from `@tensquads/ui/react`. These parts wrap UI SDK's field entry and preserve its root, label, control, description, and error slots, `render` props, state, and forwarded props. Place `Input` inside the field so UI SDK connects the label, description, and validation state to it.
- [Form](packages/ui/src/react/Form/Form.md): Import `Form` and `FormProps` from `@tensquads/ui/react`. Form composes a native form and the library FieldSet. It prevents page navigation on submit, forwards native form props, and calls `onSubmit` when enabled. `disabled` disables the field set and blocks submission. In OpenUI forms, named Field and Input text controls, Switch boolean controls, and SegmentedControl selected values participate in form state and submit together. Name the form with `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`. Compose its fields and submit button from the library.
- [Input](packages/ui/src/react/Input/Input.md): Import `Input` and `InputProps` from `@tensquads/ui/react`. Input wraps UI SDK's `Input` from `@ui-sdk/react/input`, preserving its native input, `data-slot`, `render`, value handling, and forwarded props. Use it in a `Field` or provide an `aria-label`.
- [Menu](packages/ui/src/react/Menu/Menu.md): Import `Menu`, its parts, and their prop types from `@tensquads/ui/react`. It wraps the UI SDK Menu from `@ui-sdk/react/menu`. The exported parts keep the SDK slots, `render` prop, forwarded props, and action callback shape.
- [OwnerMessageView](packages/ui/src/react/OwnerMessage/OwnerMessage.md): Import `OwnerMessageView`, `OwnerMessageViewProps`, and `pendingQuestion` from `@tensquads/ui/react`. Pass the owner messages as `messages`. The view sorts valid messages by `seq`, keeps invalid messages out of the display, and reports invalid or unknown messages through `onUnknown`. Option questions emit an `OwnerAnswer` body through `onCommand`. The host adds `commandId` and `at` before posting it.
- [PageHeader](packages/ui/src/react/PageHeader/PageHeader.md): Import `PageHeader` and `PageHeaderProps` from `@tensquads/ui/react`. PageHeader begins a full-page view with a title, one subtitle line, optional actions at the inline end, and an optional metadata row. Keep the subtitle concise and name the counts the page describes. `headingLevel` defaults to `1`; use `2` when the header appears inside a nested preview or section. On narrow screens the actions move below the copy.
- [SegmentedControl](packages/ui/src/react/SegmentedControl/SegmentedControl.md): Import `SegmentedControl`, `SegmentedControlItem` and `SegmentedControlIndicator` from `@tensquads/ui/react`. They wrap UI SDK's public segmented-control parts from `@ui-sdk/react/segmented-control` and preserve their slots, render props, value callbacks and forwarded props.
- [Sidebar](packages/ui/src/react/Sidebar/Sidebar.md): `Sidebar` is app navigation and has no OpenUI definition because navigation belongs to application chrome, not streamed content. Import `Sidebar`, `SidebarBrand`, `SidebarItem`, `SidebarSection`, `SidebarUser`, and `SidebarAgent` from `@tensquads/ui/react`.
- [Squadmate](packages/ui/src/react/Squadmate/Squadmate.md): Import `Squadmate` and the `SquadmateProps` type from `@tensquads/ui/squadmates` or `@tensquads/ui/react`. The component renders an accessible agent image. It accepts an `agent` slug, an `AgentState`, a square pixel `size` (default `64`), and a `locale` for the accessible name (default `en`). The image is not interactive and is not in the tab order.
- [StatTile](packages/ui/src/react/StatTile/StatTile.md): Import `StatTile`, `StatTileProps`, and `StatTileDelta` from `@tensquads/ui/react`. A tile shows one headline metric. `label` and `value` are required. Add an optional `glyph`, `unit`, `delta`, `foot`, and `series`. Delta tone is `positive`, `negative`, or `neutral`; the consumer decides whether an increase is good. Delta text includes its comparison period. Use `delta: null` and a `foot` when there is no previous period. Pass `series: null` or omit it for a metric without a trend. The sparkline uses the consumer-provided metric label as its accessible name. A sparkline needs at least two points and reverses in RTL so time follows the reading direction.
- [Switch](packages/ui/src/react/Switch/Switch.md): Import `Switch` and `SwitchThumb` from `@tensquads/ui/react`. They wrap the UI SDK switch parts from `@ui-sdk/react/switch` and preserve their slots, render props, checked state, callbacks and forwarded props.
- [Tooltip](packages/ui/src/react/Tooltip/Tooltip.md): Import `Tooltip`, its parts, and their prop types from `@tensquads/ui/react`. It wraps the UI SDK Tooltip from `@ui-sdk/react/tooltip` and keeps its root, trigger, content, arrow, and shortcut parts, `data-slot` values, `render` props, placement, open and delay options, and forwarded props.
